user_authorization: If there is no daily snapshot, find the last monthly snapshot and assume no change or new published points.
macro_policy: Exact snapshot if present in the pinned parent input; otherwise previous completed monthly snapshot available before the decision. Preserve original timestamps and report carry age. No backfill of prices.
financial_policy: Use exact frozen financial prediction if available; otherwise carry the previous monthly financial prediction and model. Recalculate price-based ranks and sizing daily. No new fitting schedule.
usd_policy: Use exact frozen USD snapshot if available; otherwise carry the previous monthly USD21/USD63 features with source timestamps intact. Recalculate price features daily using the existing monthly coefficients.
backfill: Stopped on user clarification. Partial new captures are retained as audit evidence but excluded from this pinned-parent study.
F3: Preserve current published F3 with adjusted-price/inherited-source-volume activity proxy. Results are a legacy-parent sensitivity comparison, not audited raw-activity transfer confirmation. Corrected-basis F3 needs a separately versioned study.
unchanged: Threshold grid, selection objective and guardrails, costs, delays, folds, funding, price batch, strategy universes and execution permissions. No monitoring or trading-policy changes.
inference: Registered paired stationary-bootstrap intervals conditional on the realized selector calendar; no selection-aware formal superiority claim. Holm 18 reported descriptively.
